description: Derived from AGSC-03-23: an item whose value for a key other than `requires`, `broader` and `narrower` names the item itself is reported once per key as the warning AGSC-E313, carried by that item. Item `a` names itself under `related` and under `uses` (with an anchor that exists, `a#top`), which are two findings on `a`, one per key; `b` is linked from `a` so neither item is an orphan. Nothing is an error: the edges are still built.
